description: Personnel do not receive security and privacy awareness training upon initial assignment and at least annually thereafter.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing training completion records, lack of training scheduling, absence of annual refresher training, and no evidence of initial onboarding security training.
